remarks: BACK ON MARKET NO FAULT OF HOME! HIGHEST AND BEST OFFER BY MONDAY 12 NOON ON 11/24/25. A classic 1920 Colonial home filled with character and charm of another era on a quiet street. Conveniently located to the Merritt Parkway, shopping and New Canaan. The living room has a wood burning fireplace and a sunroom with arched doorways and walls of windows. A full sized dining room adjacent to the kitchen which has a small eating area. The screened porch is a perfect place for summer dining or just relaxing! There are 3 bedrooms and a hall bath with tub and shower on the upper level. The full unfinished basement with washer and dryer has ample storage. A detached garage has a separate workshop or storage area. Hardwood floors throughout. Roof is approximately 2 years old and a major portion of the interior has been recently repainted with plaster repairs. This property is an ESTATE AND SUBJECT TO PROBATE COURT APPROVAL. There are no property disclosures and being SOLD AS IS. An opportunity to make this home your very own and add your personal touches! Norwalk is in the 2nd year of a 4 year phase in for the town of Norwalk.
